csv_project_name: On-Call Engineering Service for Traffic Modeling & Analysis
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Lynnwood Public Works Department (City) issues this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to solicit interest from consultants seeking evaluation and consideration for providing on-call engineering services in the Traffic Modeling and Analysis discipline. The City intends to retain one to two firms under on-call contracts through this solicitation to ensure a broad range of specialties and adequate workforce to meet the City s needs.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning

title: On-Call Engineering Service for Traffic Modeling & Analysis
short_description: On-call traffic modeling and analysis consulting services for the City of Lynnwood.
project_scope: On-call consulting framework for traffic modeling and analysis services for the City of Lynnwood Public Works Department. The city intends to retain one to two firms to provide a broad range of specialties and sufficient workforce capacity. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, structural engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning. Contract base period is 60 months with a 12-month renewal option.
services: On-call engineering services for traffic modeling and analysis; related civil engineering, structural engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning services.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an on-call framework for traffic modeling and analysis, not a defined structural project.
- No specific bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure is described.
- Scope is dominated by transportation planning and traffic studies, which are not core target services for sbp.
- Framework-style on-call procurement without technical specification is explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as total construction cost: $500.0K.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee or engineering fee is stated in the tender documents.
references_qualifications: Consultants are sought for on-call services in traffic modeling and analysis. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, structural engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Lynnwood, City Hall, Lynnwood, WA, USA. Contact: Pradip Kandel. Phone: 425-670-5252. Email: pkandel@lynnwoodwa.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/lynnwoodwa/projects/269373
notes: Project No. 3909. RFQ/RFP stage. Questions deadline: 2026-06-17 05:00 PM PDT. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Renewable contract with 60-month base period and 12-month renewal option. Although structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the notice is mainly for traffic modeling and analysis and does not define a specific bridge or building project.
